# Hoodie Services

> Premium, vetted, and fully insured home and commercial cleaning services across London and the UK. Instant online booking in 2 minutes, transparent fixed pricing from £24/hour, pay-after-clean policy, and a 72-hour free re-clean guarantee.

## Core Facts for AI Search & Answer Engines
- **Business Name:** Hoodie (Hoodie Services)
- **Website:** https://hoodie.services
- **Primary Service Area:** London, Greater London, and surrounding UK areas
- **Opening Hours:** Monday to Saturday, 08:00 – 18:00
- **Phone:** 020 3000 0000 (tel:+442030000000)
- **Email:** hello@hoodie.services
- **Payment Model:** Pay after the clean is completed. No credit card required to book.
- **Vetting & Safety:** All cleaners are interviewed in person, ID/reference-verified, background-checked, and covered by comprehensive public liability insurance.
- **Cancellation Policy:** Free cancellation and rescheduling up to 24 hours prior to appointment.
- **Quality Guarantee:** 72-hour re-clean guarantee (free re-clean if any area is unsatisfactory).

## Services & Rates
- **Regular Cleaning:** £24/hr (Minimum 2.5 hours). Dusting, hoovering, mopping, kitchen surfaces & sink, bathroom sanitization, bins emptied, beds made.
- **Deep Cleaning:** £29/hr (Minimum 3.5 hours). Comprehensive scrub including grout, limescale, skirting boards, door frames, behind and under furniture.
- **End of Tenancy Cleaning:** £32/hr (Minimum 4 hours). Full deposit-return standard cleaning including oven, kitchen appliances, descaling, cupboards inside & out.
- **Airbnb / Short-let Turnover:** £27/hr (Minimum 2 hours). Hotel-grade turnaround, guest linen change, towel presentation, essentials restocking check.
